# Buff: Sunset Sarsaparilla

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 8, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Sep 6, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d4cba8943169407bac8293570e3beaf0~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Sunset Sarsaparilla__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6c87323146bc4f1db460b1e363faaf40~mv2.jpg)

Buff:

+5% Ballistic Weapon Damage

This boosts the damage of Non-Heavy, Non-Energy guns.

Duration:

300 seconds (5 minutes)

__Source:__

CAMP Resource: Sunset Sarsaparilla Drink Machine

- Sunset Sarsaparilla has an 85% drop chance from the machine
- This item cannot be crafted
- Tradeable and can be dropped

__Additional Effects:__

- Restores 4 HP over 10 seconds
- Restores 540 thirst instantly
- Grants 1 bottlecap when consumed

__Stacking Behavior:__

This ballistic buff does not stack with the following effects:

- Bobblehead: Small Guns
- Glowing Bobblehead: Small Guns
- Ballistic Bock
- Irradiated Sunset Sarsaparilla
- Star Size Sunset Sarsaparilla

Only one of these effects can be active at a time — newer effects will overwrite older ones.

__Other Details:__

- Does not spoil
- Cannot cause addiction
- Persists on world change (the buff stays active even if you leave the world or die).
- Cola Nut perk card does not increase this buff.
- Weight: 1.00

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
